name: floorplan
description: Draw an interactive plain-English floorplan of a codebase (or a blueprint from a PRD): every subsystem, file and HTTP route named and described, with a health check, screens, guided flows and a local map server. Ask on the map answers through the ZCode CLI's read-only plan mode. Saved as a self-contained floorplan/index.html.

author.name: Hayden Smith (floorplan, MIT), ZCode packaging by Sergey
